description: This source file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder and IServiceCollection interfaces to add support for reminder services within Orleans silos. It primarily registers dependencies related to LocalReminderService, IReminderService, and IReminderRegistry.

classes.name: SiloBuilderReminderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to enhance the ISiloBuilder with reminder support, including methods to add reminders to the silo or services.

methods.name: AddReminders (ISiloBuilder)
methods.description: Extension method to add reminder support to an ISiloBuilder, configuring its services accordingly.

methods.name: AddReminders (IServiceCollection)
methods.description: Adds necessary services for reminder functionality to the provided IServiceCollection, including singleton registrations and dependency mappings.
